init.description: Configure how energy cost is recorded alongside usage. Pick a meter to set its cost source, then choose Save to apply.

meter.title: Cost source
meter.description:
### Set the cost source for {meter}.

- **Entity price:** the rate in {unit}. A `sensor` uses long-term statistics to price usage over its history; a `number`/`input_number` act as static price.
- **Static price:** a fixed rate in {unit}.

data_description.entity_id: Pick a sensor, number, or input_number holding the rate in {unit}.
data_description.price: Used when the cost source is Static. Enter the rate in {unit}.

data_description.backfill_cost: Enabling reloads the integration and reprices all past usage for every configured meter using the earliest available or static price. Leave off to price only new usage.
